entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Remove version from Microsoft.DotNet.Common.ProjectTemplates.11.0 project #52369
  • .NET SDK 10 breaking change: `dotnet pack` RID-specific tool packages adds new .exe #52365
  • C# 14 extension members cannot be consumed with SDK 8.x or 9.x #52363

Closed

  • [failing test] Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantToBuildAWindowsRuntimeComponent.ManagedWinRTComponentCanBeReferenced #52131
  • Skipped test: Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantToBuildAWindowsRuntimeComponent.ManagedWinRTComponentCanBeReferenced #52032
  • Consider: drop mono support for .NET Framework apps #51953
    11.0.1xx

    10.0.2xx
  • Dotnet format fails on C# files with primary constructors #52349
